raw_wikitext:
[[File:Upper Deck Action Figures advert.png|200px|thumb|An advert for Upper Deck's ''Huntik'' [[Action Figures]] line]]
'''Upper Deck''' is a private American company that specialises in the production and distribution of Trading cards. In 2009, Upper Deck oversaw the release of the [[Huntik Trading Card Game]] releasing three sets across the year. That same year, the company also released a range of toys which included several fully articulated action figures for [[Season 1]] of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. The following year, due to bankruptcy, they cancelled the release of the fourth set [[Labyrinth of Doom]].the company cancelled the release of future Huntik merchandise, including the release of the fourth TCG set, [[Labyrinth of Doom]].
